title: Transactional zero-restart Bahia internal configuration
intent: Apply validated mounted Bahia configuration through SIGHUP without container or process replacement, while preserving in-flight work and durable state and retaining the prior runtime on invalid candidates.
scope: in-place reload of explicitly supported mutable adapters
same-process whole-application reconstruction for other internal settings
out_of_scope: container image, mount, user, or network changes
identity, key, ACL, or custody changes
